name: Toyooka (Hyōgo, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Toyooka city emblem in light blue: a disc bearing white stylised feathers of a stork.
history: Municipal flag of Toyooka, a city in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 September 2006; the emblem dates from 10 July 2005.

features.role: Toyooka city emblem — a disc bearing white stylised feathers of a stork
